name: Build Progressive Learning Exercises
summary: Build sequenced learning exercises with explicit objectives, prerequisites, variants, and validation.
description: Build a progression of learning exercises from objectives and prerequisite skills, with learner prompts, reference solutions, feedback, accessibility, and structural validation. Use when authoring workshops, courses, or practice repositories.
risk_reason: This skill builds sequenced learning exercises with explicit objectives, prerequisites, variants, and validation; it does not auto-commit, renumber unrelated content, or rely on one proprietary course linter.
refuses: It does not create empty directories or title-only placeholders and call them complete exercises.
It does not reveal solutions in starter material or make formatting cues disclose quiz answers.

entrypoints.purpose: Validate section and exercise identifiers, prerequisite references, sequence order, variants, and required learning objectives.

operational.latency_reason: The skill builds sequenced learning exercises with explicit objectives, prerequisites, variants, and validation, using sequential evidence and verification steps.
